Spawns in cold and snowy biomes, these cuties can be tamed with seeds!
Slugs found in the ocean that produce a bouncy, sticky slime. Collect the slime with bottles, and collect the slugs with buckets!
Sleepy little bears shambling in the jungle and sleeping through the day. Thye can be bred with bamboo, or tamed with sweet berries. They do their best to scare neutral mobs.
Otters spawn in rivers, and will open clams to find hidden pearls. Clams can be fished in rivers or when defeating Drowned.
Koi fish travel together in rivers, and can be placed in buckets. Large schools of them are said to bring good fortune.
Adorable and protective arachnids, tamed with dragonfly wings. Drops a special, springy silk for uniquely sticky recipes.
Dragonflies gather over rivers, and adore spider eyes. When tamed, they can even be given armor.
Leaf Bugs spawn in forest, look like leaves and, oh boy, do they love a good jig.
A passive bug tamed with mushrooms. It heals nearby pets and nurses them back to health!
A small, sturdy friend, tamed with mushrooms. When tamed, you can place a chest upon it, and it will march forth.
A passive shelled bug, tameable with leaves. It's slime can be extracted as an alchemical ingredient.
A fiesty, passive bug that can be tamed with berries. It will defend you by flinging and ramming foes.
A passive bug that looks remarkably like a stick. When music plays nearby, it will dance.
A silly passive bug tameable with acorns. It will defend you by flinging dirt at foes.
With a taste for rabbits, chickens and digging up treasure, Ferrets make great buddies! Give them raw rabbit or chicken to tame them and then to send them plundering!
Octopuses with large 'ears', these adorable cephalopod helps out drowning players in the Deep Ocean, and can be moved with buckets.
